description: Spec 2026-06-30-earn-affiliate-slot-design.md:22-24 defines the VERIFY gate as 'each composed PNG exists, 1080x1920, non-empty'. producer.sh:40-43 implements only existence + exact dimension equality ('1080x1920'); the 'non-empty' / non-trivial content check is absent. A composed PNG is accepted purely on geometry. The clip reference enforces real content (verify_clip.sh checks 'non-black' among others, per clip/producer.sh:53). The affiliate verify has no equivalent, so the implemented gate is weaker than its own spec.
